description: Choose which way WhatsApp messages leave this tenant: 'beeper' (through the local bridge, the default), 'twilio' (through the connected AI-Call-Bot) or 'twilio_direct' (WhatsApp Business through the tenant's own Twilio account; needs a Meta-approved sender). Affects send_whatsapp only — the timeline, list_lead_messages and find_lead_by_channel do not know the difference. Call without provider to read the current setting.

provider.description: beeper | twilio | twilio_direct. Omit to only read the current value.

sender.description: twilio_direct only: the Meta-approved WhatsApp sender in E.164 (e.g. +41791234567). Stored on the Twilio connection. Can be set on its own, without changing the provider.

name: set_whatsapp_provider
